title:cover.picture.subject: a glass jug of clear water on a wooden kitchen table beside an open window, soft morning light spilling across the grain, the lower part of the frame a plain empty tabletop.

audience:audience.picture.subject: a woman seen from behind at a kitchen sink in the evening, filling a glass without looking at it, her attention on a family chatting at the table beyond.

idea:idea.picture.subject: a single water drop about to fall from the tip of a brass garden tap, the blurred green of a back garden glowing behind it in warm late sun.

execution:outdoor.picture.subject: a wide quiet street of terraced houses at dusk, a lone bus shelter glowing softly at the centre with a small puddle at its feet reflecting the warm light.

appendix:divider-1.picture.subject: a soft-focus stretch of calm river water at early morning, gentle ripples catching pale gold light on the right, the left side smooth and still.
